It’s a strange decision to feed AIs exclusively with technical analysis data. We’ve had machine learning models like LSTM, Random Forest, and XGBoost for decades — they’re excellent at crunching numbers.

The speed of algorithmic trading means inflection points (trend exhaustion) can arrive faster and with less warning than in human‐only markets. That increases risk.
Further, because algorithms may all carry similar logic (momentum, breakout, cross-asset correlation), the reversal may be more abrupt and severe.  AI creates stronger positive feedback between price and trading action to make markets move abruptly at high volume, means higher risk and a lower reward to risk ratio.
